verdict: Service in the focus hours is significantly worse than the baseline on lateness_sec.

evidence: [R] 100% of mildly late (>= 120s) trains were already late at Prospect Av (inherited delay). Origins: at or before 59 St: 7, at 53 St: 1, at or before Prospect Av: 1, at 25 St: 1. Largest time loss on segment 45 St -> 36 St (median +50s vs schedule).
50% of hours with problems ran fewer than 90% of scheduled trains (overall service delivered 89%): cancellations or missing trips are creating gaps.
MTA reports 'Infrastructure & Equipment' as 40% of delays on line(s) R, N, D, W (1.1x the system share) in the analysed months.
MTA reports 'Planned ROW Work' as 23% of delays on line(s) R, N, D, W (1.0x the system share) in the analysed months.
20% of problem arrivals happened while an MTA 'signal' alert was active for the line (problem rate 5% with an alert vs 9% without, lift 0.5x).
MTA reports 'Police & Medical' as 19% of delays on line(s) R, N, D, W (0.9x the system share) in the analysed months.

recommendations.action: Fill cancelled trips on R, N, D, W during 14:00-15:00: check crew availability and car assignments
recommendations.rationale: Fewer trains than scheduled are running in the problem hours.
recommendations.expected_effect: Restores scheduled headways; largest APT lever available.

recommendations.action: Prioritise signal maintenance / CBTC inspection on 45 St -> 36 St
recommendations.rationale: Signal alerts coincide with problem arrivals; recurring signal faults on one segment are usually a component issue.
recommendations.expected_effect: Removes the recurring gap source; typical APT reduction equals the segment's median excess run time.

recommendations.action: Check weekend / late-night planned service changes for R, N, D, W; use alternates other lines at the station
recommendations.rationale: Planned work is announced in advance.

recommendations.action: Prioritise infrastructure & equipment work orders on the R, N, D, W corridor near 4 Av-9 St
recommendations.rationale: Infrastructure categories over-index in MTA-reported delays for the line.

recommendations.action: Review the general-order (planned work) schedule for R, N, D, W; add supplement trains or move work windows off 14:00-15:00
recommendations.rationale: Problems coincide with planned service changes.
recommendations.expected_effect: Planned changes stop degrading the analysed hours.

recommendations.action: Pre-position a signal maintainer during 14:00-15:00 on days with active work orders
recommendations.rationale: Response time dominates the delay length for signal failures.
recommendations.expected_effect: Shorter incident duration, fewer 50+ train major incidents.

recommendations.action: During 14:00-15:00, check alerts for 'R, N, D, W' before entering; use the alternate routes other lines at the station when a signal alert is posted
recommendations.rationale: Signal-caused gaps last tens of minutes; alternates are usually unaffected.

sources_used: NY Open Data: trains delayed / incidents
